Container.Name: cardsheet
Container.Overview:
Drop four card images onto a Cricut Print-Then-Cut sheet and print it yourself, as many copies as you like. Cricut only does the cutting.
Reuses the registration marks from your own Design Space print-to-PDF export by stamping art over the untouched original page, and verifies after every build that not one mark pixel changed.
Upload your Design Space template PDF once on first run. It is stored in the data volume.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Stores your Design Space template PDF and every generated sheet. Back this up and you never redo the Design Space setup.

Config.Name: Card Art (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Mount a share holding your card art so the browser file picker can reach it from the server side. Not required, drag and drop from your desktop works without it.
